level.1.description.en: A small office with two people still working in it. Timing is everything.

level.1.hint.en: Did you know your colleagues always spot you if you wreak havoc right next to them? Even with their backs turned.

level.2.description.en: Watch them slaving away at their desks, left and right.

level.2.hint.en: Did you know the lighter is the basic tool of revenge?

level.3.description.en: The boss has just fired you, and now he's left the office. Get to work!

level.3.hint.en: Did you know you need two things to have a smoke?

level.4.description.en: ...and so little time! Use it wisely!

level.4.hint.en: Did you know you can check your colleagues' field of view?

level.5.description.en: This office was always too small for you. Time for great deeds.

level.5.hint.en: Did you know you can call off an action as long as the action menu is still up? Once you've started something, there's no stopping it.

level.6.description.en: ...that's how your former colleagues are working themselves to death at the office. Give them a good shake.

level.6.hint.en: Did you know some actions are no longer available if you do others first?

level.7.description.en: Destroy what no man has destroyed before.

level.7.hint.en: Did you know you can use the fax machine to send top-secret documents to the whole world?

level.8.description.en: You don't get it? We couldn't believe it either.

level.8.hint.en: Did you know the safe can be opened?

level.9.description.en: ...unusual methods may well be called for.

level.9.hint.en: Did you know some objects like to sleep with the fishes?

level.10.description.en: Your ex-colleagues are addicted to coffee and hang around in the kitchen. That gives you plenty of room to manoeuvre!

level.10.hint.en: Did you know there's a connection between microwave ovens and the air-conditioning system?

level.11.description.en: Put them to use in the toilet.

level.11.hint.en: Did you know it's not only the deed that counts, but the place as well?

level.12.description.en: Small, cosy rooms and a crowd of people - that makes for a very special atmosphere, doesn't it?

level.12.hint.en: Did you know that people who lose their workplace may start wandering around the area?

level.13.description.en: Everyone has to look after their own room. Until nature calls...

level.13.hint.en: Did you know you score more points by winding your colleagues up?

level.14.description.en: You'll find a wide selection of drinks here. And since nothing in nature ever goes to waste, you have to... Heh, you get the idea.

level.14.hint.en: Did you know soap can be used more than once?

level.15.hint.en: Did you know you can lock your colleagues in the toilet?

level.16.description.en: So he's got more important things on his mind, and nobody is keeping an eye on his office.

level.16.hint.en: Did you know a master key opens up whole new possibilities?

level.17.description.en: Show the boss exactly what you feel for him

level.17.hint.en: Did you know violence isn't the only solution?

level.18.description.en: How about clearing out the middle office for once?

level.18.hint.en: Did you know fuses can stir up a lot of trouble? They're just hard to find.

level.19.description.en: Take a good look around. Most of this stuff is scrap anyway, and scrap needs sorting.

level.19.hint.en: Did you know your ex-colleagues are very open about their intentions? Just watch the bubbles above their heads.

level.20.description.en: Fast, versatile, dynamic - those are the marks of a good office worker. It's never too late to find them in yourself - not even on your last day at work.

level.20.hint.en: Did you know bags and briefcases hide all sorts of interesting things?

level.21.description.en: Long corridors, expensive carpets, a huge spotless kitchen, attractive staff and lavish furnishings just waiting to be wrecked.

level.21.hint.en: Did you know problems can be solved verbally as well?
